categories.main_business_segments: Nantong Guosheng Intelligence Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: CNC machine tools, intelligent automated production lines, and equipment components. The CNC machine tools segment includes high-precision, high-speed, and high-efficiency metal cutting machines such as five-axis linkage vertical machining centers, gantry machining centers, and composite machining centers. The intelligent automated production lines segment provides integrated solutions including CNC machine tools and robotic automation for industries like automotive, semiconductor, and engineering machinery. The equipment components segment focuses on manufacturing precision sheet metal parts, castings, and core functional components for intelligent manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced technologies in error control, reliability, high-performance equipment components, composite processing, and secondary development and optimization. It has developed proprietary technologies for geometric, motion, and thermal error compensation, automatic online detection, and high-precision components such as five-axis cradle rotary tables and spindle units. Production methods include modular design, integrated system assembly, and automated manufacturing with a focus on import substitution for core parts. The company also applies advanced casting, welding, and machining processes to produce high-quality precision components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse range of industries including downstream mechanical equipment, precision molds, automotive, engineering machinery, industrial valves, new energy, rail transit, civil aviation, petrochemical, wind power, semiconductor, and shipbuilding. Key customers include large-scale and industry-leading enterprises in these sectors, with increasing orders from high-end product markets such as semiconductor and civil aviation. The company maintains long-term stable relationships with core domestic and international intelligent manufacturing equipment enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing bases located in Nantong, Jiangsu Province. It has expanded its overseas market presence through participation in international exhibitions and enhanced global service networks. Overseas sales account for a smaller portion of revenue compared to domestic sales, but the company is actively increasing its international customer base and improving global service responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nantong Guosheng operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures CNC machine tools and intelligent automated production lines, integrating upstream components such as precision castings and sheet metal parts, many of which are self-produced to ensure quality and cost control. The company also provides system integration, installation, and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive intelligent manufacturing equipment provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment focused on developing high-rigidity, high-speed, high-precision, and high-efficiency CNC machine tools and automation solutions tailored to customer needs. Key R&D directions include import substitution of core components like five-axis rotary tables and spindles, development of composite machining centers, and intelligent manufacturing integration. It maintains multiple ongoing projects targeting aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, wind power, and mold industries, emphasizing innovation in error compensation, reliability, and automation. The company also fosters collaboration with academic institutions and invests in talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of CNC machine tools, intelligent automated production lines, and equipment components. The company employs a mixed sales model with CNC machine tools mainly sold via distributors, while automated production lines and equipment components are sold through both direct and distributor channels. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and acceptance of products or completion of installation and commissioning, consistent with accounting standards. Additional income is derived from after-sales services and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the high-end CNC machine tool and intelligent manufacturing equipment market against established international players from Germany, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan, as well as emerging domestic competitors. It is recognized as a rapidly developing new entrant with advanced domestic technology and has received multiple industry awards and certifications. Positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer, it focuses on import substitution and expanding market share in mid-to-high-end segments, leveraging its integrated supply chain and R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.037 billion, a 6.04% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 127.98 million, down 10.3%. Total assets reached RMB 2.15 billion, up 4.52%, and shareholders' equity was RMB 1.63 billion, up 2.72%. R&D investment accounted for 5.2% of revenue. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and has a stable financial position with ongoing investments in production capacity and technology development. It has a workforce of 894 employees, including 187 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, high speed, high efficiency, and high stability in its CNC machine tools and intelligent manufacturing solutions. It differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies in error control, reliability, and high-performance components, enabling import substitution of critical parts. Its integrated product offerings, including customized automation lines and comprehensive after-sales service, provide tailored solutions that meet diverse and evolving customer needs across multiple industries. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, vertical integration, and commitment to quality and innovation underpin its competitive advantage.
